Hey everyone, does anyone know whose car got scratched in the parking last night? I did not see anything. Who is coming to Sunday's meeting? And did anyone post the expense list?

Brothers, who is coming to play cricket this evening? I will be at the ground by six. Last time someone hid the ball, so bring it yourselves this time! Then shall we go eat pani puri? I am very hungry.
Hi all, we need to collect money for tea, 20 rupees each. The office party on Friday is also fixed. If anyone has an allergy, tell me. And please reply now, not later.
Who is making dhokla in the morning? I will come at noon, no spicy food today! Do not forget two boxes like last time. If anyone took photos, please share, I want them.
Good morning everyone 🌞 Start the day by remembering God. They say if you forward this message to ten people, good things happen. Do not break the chain, it is a lucky chain!
Is this news true? Someone said water will be cut off in our society tomorrow. I do not know for sure, should we send it to everyone anyway? Please verify before forwarding.
I am sending a photo of the Ganesh immersion, it is very nice. Send this message to all neighbours, everyone in our society should see it. New Year wishes too!
All members are informed that the society meeting is on Saturday at 9 am. Topics: parking and maintenance costs. Please attend on time or send a representative.
Subscription collection starts tomorrow at six in the morning. We expect 200 rupees from each home. Suresh will have the receipt book. Those who cannot come should inform us by tonight.

Tomorrow there is a parent-teacher meeting at school at two in the afternoon. Class teacher Meenaben will meet you in class. The new part of the notebooks is pending, bring it along. We will send next week's holiday details later.
Smoke is visible in the block B building and the fire alarm is ringing. Everyone come down the stairs immediately, do not use the lift. The fire brigade is coming, nobody should go inside.
Gas smell is coming. Wing B residents, open windows, do not press lights or switches, and leave. The police have been informed. Do not let children go outside the house.
Flood situation: drain water is entering the residential area. Residents of low-lying areas should move to a safe place right now. For help, contact the nearest relief centre.
Ramesh, a delivery agent, is at the gate and has brought a parcel. Do you want to give a gate pass? Reply yes or no.
Sunita, a domestic helper, is waiting at the gate. Press the button if you want her sent in. If she is a guest you already approved, ignore this notice.
A person was seen on the door camera, standing near the steps. If it is a delivery, reply in the app. No danger is visible right now.
